## Problem

What are you trying to do that omnibias does not currently support?

## Proposed solution

Describe the API or capability you would like. If it involves a new
activation or operator, include the closed-form derivative tower (or a
reference to it) so we can keep the cross-backend math bit-identical.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you have tried or thought about.

## Scope

- Which package(s) would this touch (core / torch / jax / ferminet /
  pinn / qpinn / curvature / keras)?
- Does it need to stay bit-identical across backends?

## Additional context

Anything else relevant.
